mentions.name: KushtyBuck Records
mentions.description: This app provides communication and marketing tools for musicians, artists and producers, focused on connecting with fans rather than creating music. Features include email subscriber lists, event creation with image and text plus QR code generation from an easy-to-use dashboard, insights into QR scans, merchandise integrations with Shopify, and Hacker News-style link aggregation around music. It is built as a private Rails API with a React TypeScript frontend.
mentions.problem: Musicians have many tools for creating music but lack tools for communication with their audience.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Https://KushtyBuckRecords.com 
Been thinking a lot about tools for modern musicians/artists/producers. Not tools for creating the music but tools for communication. Email subscriber lists, event creation (image and text) combined with ability to generate QR codes and send them with easy to use dashboard, some kind of insights into the QR scans, merchandise (integrations with Shopify), hn style link aggregation around music.. been building it with my son who also becomes my product manager since he the one using the tools.
